actors.name: HR Manager
actors.description: This person is a manager of HR personnel and is responsible for ensuring that data in the system are complete, correct and up to date. This person will also run reports and analyze data in order to make organizational or individual HR decisions. This person has permission to view any record in the system.
goals: Create standard lists of data for selection in the system.
Add geographical locations to the organizational structure.
Add offices and facilities to the organizational structure.
Create a job structure for the organization.
Check for and correct data errors.
Report on data quality.
Create report views.

notes.text: Can perform any use case that HR Staff, Training Manager or Executive Manager can perform.

root.name: iHRIS Manage - Core Functional
root.description: iHRIS Manage is a human resources management tool that enables an organization to design and manage a comprehensive human resources strategy.

notes.text: This documentation refers to the core version of the HR Management database (working title: PowerTrack).
The specifications were based on the requirements gathered for the Rwanda release Version 1.0. It also includes some specifications gathered for release to IntraHealth HR department.
An earlier version of the system was released in Rwanda as RW-MOH 0.9a
Core Version 2.0 released April 16, 2007.
Core Version 3.0 released March 18, 2008.
Core Version 3.1 released August 15, 2008.
Core Version 4.0 released July 13, 2009.

The system makes the country available for selection whenever adding geographical locations or nationalities/citizenships.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing country.

steps.text: The system opens the country for editing.

extensions.text: The user selects the country as the primary country.

steps.text: The system displays the country first in all country selection menus.

extensions.text: The system determines that more than one country was selected as the primary country.

steps.text: The system displays all primary countries at the top of selection menus in alphabetical order.

extensions.text: The user selects that the country is used for location selection.

steps.text: The system makes the country available for selection when a location, such as an address, is being specified.

extensions.text: The system determines that the name and country code are the same as a country previously entered.

steps.text: The system displays an error message and will not continue.

notes.text: This use case is the same for iHRIS Manage, iHRIS Plan and iHRIS Qualify.
Geographical locations are tied together from largest to smallest: country --> region --> district, state or province --> county or sector.
The country list also displays nationalities for selection. Disabling the location selection limits the country to nationality selection only (new feature in version 3.0).
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.preconditions: The application module is enabled. The applicant has applied for a position. The user must be logged in to the system. The currency must be defined in the system for the position salary.
useCases.successGuarantee: The applicant is linked with the position and entered as an employee in the system, if not already an employee; the position is closed.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user displays the list of open positions.
The user selects the position to fill.
The system displays the position information and all applicants who applied for the position.
The user selects the applicant who will fill the position.
The system determines whether the applicant already has an employee record in the system.
The system displays today's date for the start date.
The user changes the start date, if necessary.
The user selects the currency for the salary.
The user enters the starting salary for the position.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system saves the employee record and associates it with the new position.
The system removes the person from the list of applicants.
The system marks the position as closed as of the start date.

extensions.text: The system determines that an employee record exists for the applicant and the employee is assigned to another position.

steps.text: The system prompts the user to select a status for the employee's former position: open or discontinued.
The system prompts the user to select a reason for the position change.
The system changes the status of the employee's former position as of the change date and makes it available in the open position list or list of discontinued positions.
The system adds the employee's former position to the position history with the change date as the end date for that position.

extensions.text: The system determines that the applicant already held a position with a salary.

steps.text: The system changes the salary to the new position's salary and adds the former salary to the employee's salary history.

notes.text: This use case turns an applicant into an employee and associates a position with the new employee; it can also be used to change the position for an existing employee.
Assumes that the offer has been made to the applicant and the applicant has accepted the offer (trigger).
This functionality is accessed via the Manage People --> Review Applicants screens; an open position must be selected.

packages.name: Competency Model
packages.description: Defines successful job performance in the organization and enables the organization to assess employee's competencies in various skills.

notes.text: This module is currently in development. Core functions have been released.
Also modified UC-PT20 (Create a job) to link a job to its required competencies.
The blueprint for the Competency Model module was written and posted to the wiki.

useCases.title: Create a competency model
useCases.description: The Training Manager updates a list of competency categories or competencies.
useCases.preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The new competency is saved and linked to any selected parent category, and it is available for selection in various use cases.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to update the competency model.
The system displays a list of competencies organized by category.
The user adds a new competency.
The user selects whether the item is a parent category.
The user enters the name of the item.
The user enters a definition for the competency.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the competency available for selection when adding competencies to a record.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing competency.

steps.text: The system opens the competency for editing.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing parent category.

steps.text: The system provides the option to add competencies underneath the parent category.

extensions.text: The user designates the competency as a parent category.

steps.text: The system enables competencies to be added beneath the parent category.

extensions.text: A system determines that the competency with the same parent categories already exists in the database.

steps.text: The system displays an error and will not continue.

notes.text: This use case was updated for the Competency Model module: it was expanded to add additional parent categories and to combine the competency type and competency addition into one step. Also, the primary actor was changed, and the use case was moved into a separate module that can be disabled in the system.
The system currently supports adding a competency type and several competencies under each type, which can be recorded in the qualifications section of a record; implemented in version 2.0.
This functionality can be accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update a competency evaluation
useCases.description: The Training Manager updates the competency evaluations for selection within the system.
useCases.preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The new competency evaluation is saved and available for selection when evaluating a course completed by an employee.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the list of competency evaluations.
The system displays all evaluations entered in the system.
The user adds a new competency evaluation.
The user enters the description or name of the item.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the competency evaluations available for selection when evaluating employees who have completed training courses.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing competency evaluation.

steps.text: The system opens the item for editing.

notes.text: This is a new use case to create dropdown menus of competency evaluations as part of the Competency Model module.
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Assess an employee's competencies
useCases.description: The Training Manager adds to or updates the list of competencies obtained by an employee.
useCases.preconditions: The person has a record in the system. The user must be logged in to the system. The competency and competency evaluation must be added to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The employee's competencies are saved and displayed with their record, the evaluation history for each competency is updated, and the competencies are available for searching.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to add competencies to a person's record.
The system displays the competency model.
The user selects the competency to add.
The user selects the competency evaluation (optional).
The user selects the date of the evaluation.
The user enters a date when the assessment expires or should be re-evaluated (optional).
The system sets a flag to appear on the person's record when the date has passed that reminds the user that the person needs reassessment.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system saves the competency information and displays it in the record.
The system provides the option to update the competency or view the evaluation history for any competency.

extensions.text: The system detects that the competency is a parent category.

steps.text: The user checks the category to add all subcategories and competencies within that category to the record.
The user expands the category to select subcategories or competencies within the category for addition to the record.

extensions.text: The user does not select an evaluation date.

steps.text: The system enters today's date by default.

notes.text: This use case was previously limited to adding a compentency to an employee's record, implemented in version 2.0.
Updated this use case to expand the competency model and assessment procedures as part of the Competency Model module.
This functionality can be accessed via the Qualifications section of a person's record.

packages.name: Training Management
packages.description: This module is to manage a training program offered to employees for trainings offered by the employer or external organizations. It tracks trainings that an employee has completed and assesses employee competencies achieved as a result. It also enables the organization to maintain lists of trainers and training funders.

notes.text: This module may be disabled if not used by the organization on the Configure Modules page for iHRIS Manage.
The blueprint for the Training Management module was written and posted to the wiki.
This module was developed and released in version 3.1.

useCases.title: Add or update a training funder
useCases.description: The Training Manager adds details about a training funder to the system.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The training funder is added to the system and is made available for selection in various use cases.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the list of training funders.
The system displays all funders that have been entered in the system.
The user adds a training funder.
The user enters the name of the funder.
The user adds contact information (UC-PT31).
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the training funder available for selection when adding training programs.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing funder.

steps.text: The system displays the funder's record and provides the option to edit any of the information.

notes.text: This is a new use case to create funders of training programs as part of the Training Management module.
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update a training organization
useCases.description: The Training Manager adds details about a training organization to the system.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The training organization is added to the system and is made available when adding training programs.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the list of training organizations.
The system displays all organizations that have been entered in the system.
The user adds a training organization.
The user enters the name of the organization.
The user adds contact information (UC-PT31).
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the training organization available for selection when adding training programs.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing organization.

steps.text: The system displays the organization's record and provides the option to edit any of the information.

notes.text: This is a new use case to create organizations that provide training programs as part of the Training Management module.
This use case does not track locations of training organizations, trainers or other details that properly belong in a training administration system.
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update a training course status
useCases.description: The Training Manager updates the status of training courses for selection within the system.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The new training program status is saved and available for selection when adding a training program.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the status of training courses.
The system displays all training course statuses entered in the system.
The user adds a new training course status.
The user enters the description or name of the item.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the training course status available for selection when adding training courses.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing training program status.

steps.text: The system opens the item for editing.

notes.text: This is a new use case to create dropdown menus of training program statuses as part of the Training Management module.
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update a training course requestor
useCases.description: The Training Manager updates the list of requestors of training courses for selection within the system.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The new training program requestor is saved and available for selection when scheduling a training course for an employee.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the requestors of training courses.
The system displays all training course requestors entered in the system.
The user adds a new training course requestor.
The user enters the description or name of the item.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the training course requestor available for selection when scheduling training courses for an employee.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing training program requestor.

steps.text: The system opens the item for editing.

notes.text: This is a new use case to create dropdown menus of training program requestors as part of the Training Management module.
A requestor is any person or organization who requests that an employee complete a training course (such as Employee, Supervisor, Human Resources, Donor, etc.).
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update a training course evaluation
useCases.description: The Training Manager updates the list of training course evaluations, or the grade or assessment an employee earned after taking a training course, for selection within the system.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The new training program evaluation is saved and available for selection when scheduling a training course for an employee.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the evaluations of training courses.
The system displays all training course evaluations entered in the system.
The user adds a new training course evaluation.
The user enters the description or name of the item.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the training course evaluation available for selection when scheduling training courses for an employee.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing training program evaluation.

steps.text: The system opens the item for editing.

notes.text: This is a new use case to create dropdown menus of training program evaluation as part of the Training Management module.
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update a training course category
useCases.description: The Training Manager updates the list of training course categories for selection within the system.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The new training program category is saved and available for selection when adding a training program.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the list of training course categories.
The system displays all training course categories entered in the system.
The user adds a new training course category.
The user enters the description or name of the item.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the training course category available for selection when adding training course.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing training program category.

steps.text: The system opens the item for editing.

notes.text: This is a new use case to create dropdown menus of training program categories as part of the Training Management module.
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update a continuing education course
useCases.description: The HR manager enters valid continuing education courses for selection when renewing a license.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The new continuing education course is saved and available for selection in appropriate use cases.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to update the list of continuing education courses.
The system displays all continuing education courses added to the system.
The user adds a new continuing education course.
The user enters the name of the course.
The user enters the number of credit hours that can be earned by completing the course.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system makes the new course available for selection when adding training courses.

extensions.text: The user selects an existing continuing education course name.

steps.text: The system opens the course's details and provides the option to update them.

notes.text: This is a new use case that is part of the training management module.
This use case is identical to the same use case for iHRIS Qualify.
This functionality is accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Add or update an in-service training program
useCases.description: The Training Manager adds a training offering to the system that can be requested for employees to complete.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The competencies must be entered in the system. The training category, status, funder and organization must be entered in the system. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The training program is added to the system and is made available for selection.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to manage the list of training courses.
The system displays all training courses entered in the system.
The user adds a training program.
The user enters the name of the training program.
The user selects the category of the training (optional).
The user enters a specific topic for the training.
The user selects the program status.
The user selects the name of the training funder (optional).
Repeat for each additional training funder.
The user selects the name of the training organization giving the training (optional).
The user checks all competencies associated with the training (optional).
The user selects any Continuing Education course credits earned in the training program (optional).
The user enters any notes about the training (optional).
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system displays the training course information.
The user enters the schedule for a training program (UC-PT57).

extensions.text: The user selects an existing program.

steps.text: The system displays the training program record and provides the option to edit the training program information.

extensions.text: The user does not select a status.

steps.text: The system sets the status to open.

extensions.text: The user selects the closed status.

steps.text: The system removes the training from scheduling on an employee's record.

extensions.text: The user checks a parent competency category.

steps.text: The system selects all subcategories and competencies within that category for the training.

extensions.text: The user expands a parent competency category.

steps.text: The system makes any subcategory or competency within that category available for selection.

notes.text: This use case has been significantly revised to capture more data about training programs as part of the Training Management module.
This functionality can be accessed via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.
The In-Service Training Management module must be enabled for the use case to function and is disabled by default.

useCases.title: Enter the schedule for a training program
useCases.description: The Training Manager enters the specific dates, duration and location of training program classes, either when entering the training program details or scheduling an employee to take a training.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The training program has been entered in the system. The country, district and county where the training program is located must be entered in the system. The user is logged in.
useCases.successGuarantee: The training class details are saved with the training program and made available for later reference.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the training course to schedule.
The user selects the option to schedule a training program.
The user enters the maximum number of students.
The user selects the date the training program begins.
The user selects the date the training program ends.
The user enters the name of the site where the training program is to be held.
The user enters the trainers' name(s) (optional).
The user selects the country where the training program takes place.
The system displays all districts in that country.
The user selects the district where the training program takes place.
The system displays all counties in that district.
The user selects the county where the training program takes place (optional).
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system saves the class details with the training program information and makes the class available for scheduling for employees.

extensions.text: The date is not entered.

steps.text: The system selects the current date.

extensions.text: The end date is before the start date.

steps.text: The system displays an error and will not continue.

notes.text: This use case was added to allow scheduling of specific instances of a training program.
This functionality is accessed from a training course's record via the Configure System --> Administer Database screens.

useCases.title: Schedule a training for an employee
useCases.description: The Training Manager adds an employee to the schedule for a training class.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. The user must be logged in to the system. The employee must have a record in the system. The training program must have been added to the system and at least one class must have been added for it. The requestor and evaluation must have been added to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The training program is listed as scheduled in the employee's training history.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user selects the option to schedule a training in an employee's record.
The system lists all training programs.
The user selects the training program.
The system displays all scheduled classes for that program.
The user selects the training class to schedule.
The system displays today's date for the date of the request.
The user changes the date of the request, if applicable.
The user selects the person who requested or recommended the training (optional).
The user selects whether this is a new training or a retraining for the employee.
The user enters any notes about the training request.
The user selects whether the course has been completed.
The user selects an evaluation for the course.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system adds the training program to the list of the trainings in which the employee is scheduled to take to the employee's training history.

extensions.text: The user doesn't select an option.

steps.text: The system records No by default.

notes.text: This is a new use case as part of the Training Management module.
This functionality is accessed via the Training section of a person's record. The In-Service Training Management Module must be enabled.

useCases.title: Assess training results and update competencies
useCases.description: After an employee has completed a training, the Training Manager assesses their performance and updates their qualifications accordingly.
useCases.preconditions: The training module is enabled. A training with associated competencies has been scheduled for the employee. The competency evaluation has been entered in the system. The user must be logged in to the system.
useCases.successGuarantee: The training is marked complete and the results are recorded in the Employee's training history.

mainSuccessScenario.text: The user opens an employee's training history in the employee's record.
The user selects the course competency evaluation for the training that the employee completed from the list of scheduled trainings.
The system displays all competencies selected for the training, if any.
For each competency associated with the training, the user selects the evaluation (optional).
The user enters the date of the evaluation.
The user enters a date when the assessment expires or should be re-evaluated (optional).
The system sets a flag to appear on the person's record when the date has passed that reminds the user that the person needs reassessment.
The user enters any notes about the evaluation.
The user saves the record (UC-ICE2).
The system saves the completed training in the employee's training history as completed (rather than scheduled) and records the performance.
The system adds the assessed competencies to the employee's record.

extensions.text: No date is entered.

steps.text: The system records today's date by default.

notes.text: This is a new use case as part of the Training Management module.
The In-Service Training Management Module must be enabled to access this functionality. It is disabled by default.
This functionality is accessed via the Training section of a person's record.

requirements.name: Localization
requirements.description: The system must support different international currencies.

requirements.name: Job applicant questions
requirements.description:
Specifies all questions that the organization requires be asked of a job applicant, such as to satisfy a law or the organization's need.

Example job applicant questions: If you are not a citizen, are you authorized to work in the country? Have you ever been convicted of a felony? If yes, describe the circumstances. How did you hear of this opening? When can you start work? What is your desired wage? Are you looking for full-time employment? What hours are you available?

requirements.name: Privacy
requirements.description: Some data cannot be viewed except by specified roles in HR and management. These may change depending on laws and organizational policies, but will probably always include salary and identification numbers.
